title: Downtown Toronto · King West
description: Real street pattern of Toronto's Entertainment District, Front St to Queen St and Peter St to Simcoe St, imported from OpenStreetMap: the Richmond/Adelaide one-way pair, King and Queen streetcar arterials, side streets that end at T-junctions and stop-controlled lanes such as Widmer and Mercer.
